method: Blind final-pixel review. Viewed all four supplied references before individually viewing all forty candidate captures in the supplied candidate and capture orders. Each screen score conservatively considers both sizes. Scores reflect the references' painted gold, lavender lettering, dark textile grounds, and physically joined ornament rather than incremental improvement. Intentional large type and scrolling are preserved; partial content behind a visible reading boundary is not treated as inaccessible. No interaction conclusions. Standalone preview banners and unchanged combat room, actor, and hand art were excluded; combat background scores concern the visible supporting grounds for the judged overlay labels, not the room painting. No candidate identities inferred. No screen reaches the same-hand 9 threshold.

winner_fixes: Rest, event, gameover, and shop: repaint the large upper lavender title faces with irregular pale edge catches, dark inner bevels, and subtle chips, retaining the current letter size and spacing.

Combat-floaters, upper status groups: give each condition a worn aubergine backing with a readable gold edge thickness and move the side curls clear of the leading plus signs; retain the crisp cyan and coral colors.

Gameover, right final-deck list: retain the mottled row texture, add localized wear on its shaped rims, and replace the broad dissolve on the last visible row with a narrow shadow where rows pass behind the fitted lip.
Event, bottom of the reading sheet: narrow the rail face and paint a continuous paper-to-lip contact shadow with joined corner ends so the paper clearly sits recessed in the stand.
Rest, right choice boards: vary local warm edge light and cloth wear across the long panels, and fit each outcome badge's texture tightly to its shaped silhouette.
Rest, event, gameover, and shop, lower rails: use proportionate small center ornaments and believable end joints; avoid making the full-width purple fascia heavier than the frame it belongs to.

Shop, title and shelf trim: preserve the curtain staging, merchant portrait, card size, and hanging prices while bringing the rail's worn metal and the title's carved finish to the same tactile standard.

grafts.idea: Use the narrow battered gold reading lip and visible lower edge as the model for a more fitted paper recess; preserve FLUORITE's richer face texture elsewhere.
Use the lower rail's restrained height and compact end treatment so the merchandise shelf remains the focus.
Borrow the quieter brown rail face as a color cue for connecting choice-board trim to the room's wood, while retaining FLUORITE's textured badges.
